      "pins": ["C89.1", "C89.2", "M6.J1_8", "R29.2"],
      "nets": ["NET0071", "+3V3", "GND", "NET0008"],
      "observed": "C89 (100n) connects the IO1 input net NET0071 to +3V3, not to GND. IO1 is otherwise pulled to GND by R29 (10k). The mirror-image input on IO0 (NET0008) uses C62 (100n) returned to GND, with R47 (10k) as the pull-up to +3V3.",
      "expected": "The debounce/filter capacitor on a float-switch input should return to GND, matching C62 on IO0. A capacitor sitting in the pull-up position to +3V3 does not filter the switch edge and is inconsistent with the intended pull-down on IO1.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"C89\") (pin \"1\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"C89\") (pin \"2\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R29\") (pin \"1\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"C62\") (pin \"1\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "C89 NET0071 +3V3 100n"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "C62 0 NET0008 100n"}
      ],
      "impact": "The IO1 float-switch input loses its intended RC debounce and is held only by the 10k pull-down, so the input is less noise-immune and may chatter. The capacitor's connection to the 3.3 V rail is a wiring error.",
      "confidence": 0.5
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "components": ["T4", "R8", "D1"],
      "pins": ["T4.1", "T4.2", "T4.3", "R8.1", "R8.2", "D1.1"],
      "nets": ["NET0017", "/+24V_{F}", "+24V"],
      "observed": "The gate of the P-channel AON6407 (T4.1) is on NET0017, which connects only to R8 (33k, gate to /+24V_F, the source), D1 (12V zener cathode) and T4.1. Nothing drives the gate, and R8 ties it to the source, so Vgs is held at 0 V.",
      "expected": "A P-channel input (reverse-polarity or power-switch) device needs its gate pulled to ground through R8 and driven by a control or protection network. Its gate should not be held at the source potential with no driver.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"T4\") (pin \"1\") (pinfunction \"G\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R8\") (pin \"2\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"D1\") (pin \"1\") (pinfunction \"K\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "R8 /NET0017 /+24VF 33k"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "README states the PCB includes \"reverse polarity protection, TVS diodes, proper isolation\""}
      ],
      "impact": "The P-FET stays off, so the 24 V input reaches the +24V rail only through the device body diode. The intended switch or reverse-polarity function does not operate, and the board loses its designed input protection.",
      "confidence": 0.3
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "components": ["R40", "R18", "T7", "T8"],
      "pins": ["R40.2", "R40.1", "T7.1", "T8.3"],
      "nets": ["NET0044", "+3V3", "NET0024"],
      "observed": "The gate of the IRLR2905 main-pump low-side switch T7 (NET0044) is pulled up to +3V3 through R40 (10k). Only the BT3904 T8 can pull it low, so the gate defaults high when T8 is off.",
      "expected": "A pump low-side switch should default to off, with its gate pulled to GND as in the parallel AO3400A stage (R33 pulls T6's gate to GND).",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R40\") (pin \"2\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"T7\") (pin \"1\") (pinfunction \"G\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R33\") (pin \"1\") (pintype \"passive\"))"}
      ],
      "impact": "The main pump can run whenever T8 is not actively pulling the gate low, for example when IO10 is floating, so the pump has no default-off state.",
      "confidence": 0.2
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The most concrete deviation is C89, a 100n capacitor wired from the IO1 float-switch input to +3V3 instead of GND, which breaks the debounce arrangement mirrored by C62 on IO0. The P-FET T4 with its gate tied to its own source and no driver, and the pump gate pull-up R40, are lower-confidence concerns."
}

anomalies.observed: C89 (100n) connects the IO1 input net NET0071 to +3V3, not to GND. IO1 is otherwise pulled to GND by R29 (10k). The mirror-image input on IO0 (NET0008) uses C62 (100n) returned to GND, with R47 (10k) as the pull-up to +3V3.
anomalies.expected: The debounce/filter capacitor on a float-switch input should return to GND, matching C62 on IO0. A capacitor sitting in the pull-up position to +3V3 does not filter the switch edge and is inconsistent with the intended pull-down on IO1.
anomalies.impact: The IO1 float-switch input loses its intended RC debounce and is held only by the 10k pull-down, so the input is less noise-immune and may chatter. The capacitor's connection to the 3.3 V rail is a wiring error.

anomalies.observed: The gate of the P-channel AON6407 (T4.1) is on NET0017, which connects only to R8 (33k, gate to /+24V_F, the source), D1 (12V zener cathode) and T4.1. Nothing drives the gate, and R8 ties it to the source, so Vgs is held at 0 V.
anomalies.expected: A P-channel input (reverse-polarity or power-switch) device needs its gate pulled to ground through R8 and driven by a control or protection network. Its gate should not be held at the source potential with no driver.

evidence.quote: README states the PCB includes "reverse polarity protection, TVS diodes, proper isolation"

anomalies.impact: The P-FET stays off, so the 24 V input reaches the +24V rail only through the device body diode. The intended switch or reverse-polarity function does not operate, and the board loses its designed input protection.

anomalies.observed: The gate of the IRLR2905 main-pump low-side switch T7 (NET0044) is pulled up to +3V3 through R40 (10k). Only the BT3904 T8 can pull it low, so the gate defaults high when T8 is off.
anomalies.expected: A pump low-side switch should default to off, with its gate pulled to GND as in the parallel AO3400A stage (R33 pulls T6's gate to GND).
anomalies.impact: The main pump can run whenever T8 is not actively pulling the gate low, for example when IO10 is floating, so the pump has no default-off state.
